page_title: LEN 3-1 STR | Lens v Strasbourg 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.

90+3' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Willy Delajod had a clear view and blows his whistle.
89' The Strasbourg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
88' Substitution. Facundo Medina did his best and is replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).
85' Good play from Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.

83' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Wesley Said (Lens) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the bottom left corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Alaa Bellaarouch makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
83' The referee awards a corner and David Pereira da Costa (Lens) goes over to take it.
81' It's time for a substitution. Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) comes on in place of Florian Sotoca.
81' Here is a change. Jhoanner Chavez is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).
80' The free kick from long range, taken by Lens, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
80' Florian Sotoca (Lens) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Mwanga trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg).
76' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
74' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
73' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
72' Substitution. Thomas Delaine walks off the pitch and Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
71' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Elye Wahi is replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) is replacing Andy Diouf.

70' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom right corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Brice Samba, who gets down to save.
68' Lens restart play with a quick free kick.
68' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

66' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Andy Diouf (Lens) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the top left corner, but it was an easy job for the goalkeeper to make a save.
65' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Jonathan Gradit (Lens) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
65' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:4.

64' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Brice Samba!
61' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way wide of the right post.
61' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

61' Brice Samba makes a good save! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
60' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' 3 - 1 Goal Florian Sotoca (Lens)! Florian Sotoca (Lens) was put through by David Pereira da Costa and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top of the net. 3:1.
55' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
55' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
54' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Willy Delajod no option but to blow his whistle.
53' Elye Wahi (Lens) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
51' Dangerous play by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg). Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

48' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Brice Samba, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes out for a corner. Strasbourg can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Strasbourg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45+3' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+2' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
45+1' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 1 Goal! Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
42' A raking crossfield pass from Florian Sotoca (Lens) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
40' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
39' Dilane Bakwa slips the ball to Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg), who hastily shoots from distance and sends the ball well wide of the left post.
37' Strasbourg take the free kick with a short pass.
37' Caution goes to Facundo Medina (Lens).
35' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Brice Samba was alert and made a comfortable save.
34' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
33' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' 2 - 0 Goal! Elye Wahi provides David Pereira da Costa (Lens) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
29' The possession of the ball – 60:40.
28' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
25' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
22' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
22' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
19' Willy Delajod blows his whistle. Florian Sotoca (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick is awarded to Strasbourg.
16' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! David Pereira da Costa tees up Elye Wahi (Lens) inside the box and he rolls the ball past Alaa Bellaarouch.
15' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Facundo Medina (Lens) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Ruben Aguilar with a lovely through ball.
12' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!
10' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

8' Facundo Medina (Lens) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the top of the net. Alaa Bellaarouch is alert, though, and makes a great save to deny him.
7' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) jumps into a tackle and Willy Delajod signals a foul. Lens will take a free kick.
6' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) takes the corner but it's cleared.
6' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' An attempted cross from Florian Sotoca (Lens) is cleared. Now Lens have a corner.

3' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
1' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will referee today's match.
